description: This file defines a UI Button component using the Lightning.js Blits framework, including props for styling and behavior, with methods for interaction effects.

methods.name: bgColor
methods.description: Computes background color based on the button's variant.

methods.name: txtColor
methods.description: Determines text color based on the button's variant.

methods.name: effects
methods.description: Returns visual effects for the button based on variant.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Handles focus state by changing hover alpha.

methods.name: unfocus
methods.description: Handles loss of focus by resetting hover alpha.

methods.name: pointerover
methods.description: Handles mouse over event to set hover effect.

methods.name: pointerout
methods.description: Handles mouse out event to reset hover effect.
